Page 50
Jan. Jan. 1948 Mission Digest. "Approximately, there are now in the mission fields of the world: 22,500 Priests, 53,000 Nuns, 76000 Teachers, 92000 Catechists. The Church is making about 800,000 converts a year. Two million children being taught in mission schools.
Salesian Bulle.
Greatest persecutions Church Ever Endured Now On. ."Only 12 yrs.
Jan 27 1949 Page 51 Ser. Mass Assoc'n 1949, May -
May 30th Marcia Anna Fabian - Months old, "hopeless" - brain tumor in Reilly Hospita. - Indianapolis - enrolled in S.M.Ass'n - Mother not Catholic but believes in Jesus, comes in afterwards. .. June 3rd parents return; no improvement in baby's condition - possibly worse." Parents enroll - selves. They are urgent to "promise" - he to get back to holy sacraments, etc, - she to study up about religion, etc. if Baby is spared etc. - enrolling selves for a year.
Oct. Ist Notable Case. 1949 -Bobby Sweeney 6 of - Christ the King Parish Detroit reported yesterday "threatening condition ... Para Lukemia" ..... Friends had promised their car if little B. were well enough to make the trip .... First Holy Communion in bed last Sunday. ... fever all week 103 to 106 till phone call yesterday - "Emergency Enrollment" Received this a.m. Ist time in Church is here this p.m. - bright and smiling .... alert. Oct. 17th Bobby continues to improve - Back to school and doing fine - No further traces of lukemia. Deo Gr.
Page 52
Oct. 3 Helen Gmyrek - about 30 - Corpus Christi Parish - Hamtramck - Believed to be Possessed, here,,,,,,upper body and arms (half) naked - bound with clothes-line .... Blest her with relic of the Cross ..... out in front of chapel ... Had bitten her father ... violent at times. Behaviour not too bad to-day.
Nov. 3rd Deo Gratias ! Same H.G. came to Monastery Office To-day smilingly, shook hands and .... received blessing out in Church. 80% improved. Deo Gr. Thanks be to God.
Nov. From Elmira, New York - Nov. $1.00 Amedes 54-55 -enrolled in Sept. last ... Hopeless cancer of esophagus ..... In one week, swallowing normal ... gained 5 1bs ...... Instead of sending him home - cured - Dr's gave him deep therop ... treatments and at once cancer mani- fested itself .... now spread worse than ever. Enrolled again To-day when Dr's have absolutely no hope of helping, giving patient at most 2 weeks to live. Sister-in-law enrolls Poor Souls for same intention.
